title: Pool protocol v1 event envelope
description: Envelope for every pool protocol message. Router -> coordinator messages are POSTed to /pool/events as this envelope; coordinator -> router messages arrive as SSE data: lines on the held-open GET /pool/subscribe with the same envelope. "type" selects the payload schema: schemas/<type>.json defines the full envelope for one message type. Heartbeats are SSE comment lines (": hb <unix_ms>"), not envelopes.

type.description: Message type. Stable, snake_case. Closed set for protocol v1; new types require a protocol bump (D-J6).

payload.description: Type-specific payload object. Its shape is defined by the "payload" property of schemas/<type>.json.
